posts.caption_text: Northbridge Outfitters is pleased to announce the launch of our Spring Trail Collection, engineered for durability across all terrain types.
Our commitment to sustainable materials continues with the introduction of recycled nylon shells across our outerwear line.
Please join us at our flagship location for the Spring Collection preview event on April 2nd.
Northbridge Outfitters extends its gratitude to customers for another successful quarter.
